April 2016 is Equine Flu Awareness Month. For expert advice on how you can best protect your horses and others they come into contact with, take a look at the range of Equine Flu Awareness videos from Merial Animal Health Ltd. 

These videos are packed with information and advice from leading equine veterinarians and specialists in animal diseases. They can help you to recognise the signs and symptoms of equine flu, how it spreads, and how correct vaccination and biosecurity can help manage the disease. The videos also outline the role of flu virus surveillance in the UK, which is supported by The Horserace Betting Levy Board Equine Influenza Surveillance Programme run by the Animal Health Trust, and how this influences vaccination guidance and development of vaccines.

Brought to you by Merial, the manufacturers of ProteqFlu® vaccines.
